public_payload.normalized_proposition: By Zitron's partly estimated tally, Anthropic needs about $380 billion over the next four years: $330 billion in cloud obligations to Amazon, Google and Microsoft, an estimated $20 billion for its xAI compute deal, and an estimated $30 billion for its CoreWeave deal.

statement.excerpt: I’d estimate it needs $5 billion a year for its compute deal xAI (so $20 billion over the total period) and an estimated $30 billion to cover its deal with CoreWeave. That brings us to a total of $380 billion.

from_speaker: $330 billion to pay its cloud obligations
our_interpretation: Assess the commitments existing on May 19, 2026, not every agreement or amendment signed later.
Read the four-year payment window as May 19, 2026 through May 19, 2030.
Treat $380 billion as an approximate estimate assembled from the five named providers, not an audited liability.
The observation concerns the estimated obligations already incurred. It is distinct from a forecast of all future compute spending.
Later disclosures can illuminate earlier agreements, but later amendments cannot be attributed to the publication-date commitment.
criteria.support_condition: Contract terms and payment schedules for the five named providers substantiate approximately $380 billion payable within the four-year window, including the stated component estimates.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A complete comparable schedule establishes a materially different total payable within that window, or reliable original contract terms decisively disprove a stated component on the same basis.
